propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured with a single bounded Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter to preserve authoritative inputs and stored responses under one shared request budget and retry counter.

Implement wire-context projection via pydantic-ai history_processors to selectively include failed ModelResponses only when their full token usage plus effective_max_tokens fits the model window, omitting entire responses rather than truncating them.

Add a concision-aware guard for the prompted-output branch that detects length/max_tokens truncation signals and retries with a concision instruction, while keeping NativeOutput branch with pai_output.guard_capability unchanged and terminal.

Combine request budget and output-retry allowance into one operation-wide UsageLimits with no per-attempt reset, keeping the bare base req_limit as the returned value for telemetry and completion_banking inverse calculation.
Raise ContextWindowExceededError when authoritative input alone exceeds context window without shortening system/user/tool content.
Preserve NativeOutput mode selection, bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback, and native truncation as terminal while replacing only the manual for-loop scheduling.
